title: swisseph-ffi: refcounted handle sharing (swisseph_share / Arc-backed free)
description:
## Parent

yojana:swisseph-rs-dart/20 (PRD v2) — upstream prerequisite for the Dart sharing surface. Decision record: swisseph.rs.dart/docs/adr/0002 (Arc at the FFI boundary).

## What to build

Make the opaque handle refcounted at the FFI boundary so co-equal handles can be freed in any order: internally wrap the engine in Arc; add `swisseph_share(handle)` returning a new handle that clones the Arc; `swisseph_free` becomes a refcount drop (last drop frees the engine). Regenerate the cbindgen header.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `swisseph_share` exported, documented in swisseph.h with ownership semantics (every handle freed exactly once, any order)
- [ ] `swisseph_free` on a shared handle does not invalidate siblings; last free releases engine memory (asserted via FFI test)
- [ ] Concurrency test: N threads calc over shared handles while others free theirs — no UB under miri/sanitizer where feasible
- [ ] Zero behavior change for single-handle users; existing FFI tests green
- [ ] Version bump so the Dart shim can pin a rev containing this

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex adversarial review: **approve**. No material findings. Arc clone/drop lifecycle correctly represented at the FFI boundary, shared handles remain distinct Box allocations, explicit date derefs correct for DeltaT bound, header exports/documents swisseph_share ownership semantics.
